That's the greatest wonder of rereading the Wheel of Time, and New Spring in particular - every time I stumble across a new detail that I'd missed or forgotten. For instance, how many remember by heart that Siuan had eight uncles and at least one older sister, or that Kerene's hair was dusted with white, or Pritalle and Alanna being good friends of Edesina's? I find New Spring maybe the best book of the series, sharing the first place with A Memory of Light, closely followed by Lord of Chaos, damn, that's a good one, and maybe the Gathering Storm or Knife of Dreams. 

As for Katerine, yep, I agree she would have killed Egwene. Barasine would not have had any objections. Had they only gotten rid of Merym, Jala Bandevin and Felaana Bevaine, I think Egwene's life would have ended there. Katerine knew fully well what a powerful force Egwene could become.
